text:
maria: heads-up — seeing a 95th pct tail jump (~700ms) on canary. attached perfetto trace: gs://redwood-perf/traces/1872345678/perfetto.pbz2
aj: yikes. which span — client->gateway or runtime?
maria: client->gateway looks fine. runtime span shows a ~500ms stall during kernel selection/swap. perfetto timeline has a big memcpy right before kernel launch.
kevin: can you paste the perfetto/nSys snippet? even a trimmed timeline helps.
maria: here’s the trimmed perfetto slice (manually annotated):
```
runtime_span:
  span_start: 0ms
  kernel_select: 12ms
  kvcache_lookup: 3ms
  kernel_swap_wait: 480ms  # large H2D memcpy observed
  start_kernel: 5ms
  execution: 20ms
  span_end: 520ms
```
aj: kernel_swap_wait — sounds like swapping in a different kernel binary/weights. could be CUDA page-in or model-variant memcpy.
sara: we saw a similar pattern on long-sequence requests; batcher chose an int8 kernel variant that wasn't resident and triggered weight page-in. that causes big H2D memcpy and stalls the worker.
devon: @perf-bot can you attach the nsys summary for trace 1872345678?
perf-bot: nsys summary (trace 1872345678): GPU memcpy H2D = 462ms, kernel-launch overhead ~4ms, CPU blocked on file IO 210ms, GPU busy time 22ms.
kevin: cpu blocked on file IO — which process? looks like runtime-worker-3 from the trace.
maria: confirmed worker-3. syslog excerpt shows repeated soft page faults and kmod warnings: 
```
Mar 15 03:12:02 runtime-worker-3 kernel: __handle_mm_fault: BUG: soft page fault for /mnt/models/quantized/v2/weights at 0x7f9a...
Mar 15 03:12:02 runtime-worker-3 runtime: WARN kvcache: miss amplification detected count=7 seq_len=1536
Mar 15 03:12:03 runtime-worker-3 cuda: info: initiating H2D transfer of 814MB
```
aj: short-term mitigation: tweak batching heuristic to prefer cached kernel variants when seq_len > 1024 and clip batch size to avoid triggering swap. can we repro with nsys+perfetto on canary?
sara: I'll schedule an overnight perf job. command outline: `python -m runtime.tracing --trace perfetto --nsys --sample-seq 1200 --batch-size 8 --tag repro-1872345678`
devon: repro job created: jobs/repro-1872345678. will attach perfetto + nsys links when finished.
maria: also adding a temporary routing guard: if kvcache miss rate > 0.05 route traffic to dedicated pool to avoid noisy page-ins. opening PR for routing-escape now.
aj: good plan. once we have the nsys flamegraph, let's check memcpy origin (weights vs mmaped metadata). please post flamegraph snapshot here. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: noted and will post artifacts under gs://redwood-perf/artifacts/1872345678 when job completes. tagging owners: @maria @sara @aj.
kevin: one more ask — add a small nvprof run to capture driver memcpy stacks, sometimes nsys misses the root cause.
sara: will include nvprof snippet in the job.
maria: thanks all — priority P1 for the canary pool until we mitigate. reopening the rollout hold until PR + repro artifacts are in.
